To the right, there is a dark, vertical surface (possibly a mirror or wall) reflecting some light and showing faint specks of mist or spray in the air. A hand holding an object (presumably the hair spray can) is partially visible at the top right, but the can itself is largely out of frame or obscured. The focus is on the hair and the airborne spray particles.
